```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(fivethirtyeight) 

candy <- fivethirtyeight::candy_rankings 

candy <- candy |> 
  mutate(type = case_when(
    chocolate & fruity ~ "both",
    chocolate ~ "chocolate",
    fruity ~ "fruity",
    .default = "other"
  ))

# count(candy, type)
```

## Row 1 {height="15%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Candies"

list(
  icon = "basket", 
  color = "warning", 
  value = nrow(candy))

```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Number of Fruity Candies"


list(
  icon = "heart-fill",
  color = "#E4572E",
  value = sum(candy$type == "fruity"))

```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Number of Chocolate Candies"

list(
  icon = "heart",
  color = "#7B4B2A",
  value = sum(candy$type == "chocolate"))
```

## Row 2

```{r}
boxplot <- ggplot(candy, aes(type, winpercent, color = type, fill = type)) + 
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.15, width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA) + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(y = "Win %",
       x = "Candy Type")

ggplotly(boxplot)
```

```{r}
bar <- ggplot(candy, aes(winpercent, reorder(competitorname, winpercent), fill = type)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 4)) +
  labs(y = "Candy Name",
       x = "Win %")

ggplotly(bar)
```
